Driver.description: A driver in the Layer 4 catalogue.

id.description: Stable snake_case id used by the impact matrix.
id.title: Id

group.description: revenue | margin | capital | financial_risk | terminal | archetype_specific.
group.title: Group

unit.description: decimal | bps | days | currency | ratio | multiplier.
unit.title: Unit

default_range.description: Set at archetype level; overridable per company.

dependencies.description: Other driver ids; required where role == derived.
dependencies.title: Dependencies

derivation_formula.description: Required where role == derived. Plain-language or expression form, e.g. 'wacc = (E/V) * cost_of_equity + (D/V) * cost_of_debt_pretax * (1 - tax_rate)'.
derivation_formula.title: Derivation Formula

scenario_sensitive.description: Whether the impact matrix may move it. Must be False where role == derived (derived drivers are computed by Layer 6, not written by Layer 5).
scenario_sensitive.title: Scenario Sensitive

base_definition.description: latest_reported_fy | ttm | three_year_avg | ntm_consensus — used by Layer 6 (section 11.2) to anchor deltas against base-year values.
base_definition.title: Base Definition

default_time_profile.description: Default time-profile name from the section 11.3 library, with parameters bundled (e.g. 'regime_shift(phase_in_years=3)').
default_time_profile.title: Default Time Profile

aggregation_method.description: revenue_weighted_avg | ebit_weighted_avg | sum | identity_if_company_scope — used by Layer 6 (section 11.2) to roll segment values to company level.
aggregation_method.title: Aggregation Method

Driver.title: Driver

DriverRange.description: Default min / mid / max for a driver under a given archetype (section 9.2).
DriverRange.title: DriverRange

DriverRole.description: Whether a driver is written by Layer 5 or computed by Layer 6 (section 9.2).
DriverRole.title: DriverRole

ValuationModel.description: Which valuation engine consumes the driver (section 9.2).
ValuationModel.title: ValuationModel

description: Top-level wrapper for data/drivers/<id>.yaml or a catalogue file.
title: DriverFile
